package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestRequireInternalTokenProtectsDiagnosticRoute(t *testing.T) {
	next := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK) })
	route := RequireInternalToken("diagnostic-secret")(next)
	for name, token := range map[string]string{"missing": "", "wrong": "other", "correct": "diagnostic-secret"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", nil)
			if token != "" {
				req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
			}
			resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
			route.ServeHTTP(resp, req)
			want := http.StatusForbidden
			if name == "correct" {
				want = http.StatusOK
			}
			if resp.Code != want {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d", resp.Code, want)
			}
		})
	}
}
